article.story: No. 11 Oklahoma (1-0) at Michigan (1-0), Sept. 12 at 12 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Oklahoma by 5.5. Against the spread: Oklahoma 1-0, Michigan 0-1. How to watch: FOX Key stats Oklahoma Offense Overall: 401 yards per game (70th in FBS) Passing: 231 yards per game (69th) Rushing: 170 yards per game (63rd) Scoring: 51 points per game (26th) Oklahoma Defense Overall: 198 yards per game (30th in FBS) Passing: 86 yards per game (12th) Rushing: 112 yards per game (71st) Scoring: 0 points per game (1st) Michigan Offense Overall: 276 yards per game (120th in FBS) Passing: 170 yards per game (102nd) Rushing: 106 yards per game (110th) Scoring: 13 points per game (114th) Michigan Defense Overall: 221 yards per game (38th in FBS) Passing: 89 yards per game (15th) Rushing: 132 yards per game (79th) Scoring: 12 points per game (47th) Michigan is 112th in third down percentage, converting 30% of the time. Oklahoma ranks 16th on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 15.4%. Michigan is 131st in the FBS with a -3 turnover margin, compared to Oklahoma's 34th-ranked +1 margin. Michigan ranks 117th in the FBS averaging 80 penalty yards per game, compared to Oklahoma's 18th-ranked 30 per-game average. Both teams have strong red zone offenses, each scoring on 100% of trips to lead the FBS. Michigan ranks 135th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 19:52, compared to Oklahoma's 73rd-ranked average of 30:32. Team leaders Oklahoma Passing: John Mateer, 225 yards, 3 TDs, 0 INTs, 64.7 completion percentage Rushing: Lloyd Avant, 79 yards on 15 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Isaiah Sategna, 76 yards on 4 catches, 1 TD Michigan Passing: Bryce Underwood, 170 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT, 54.5 completion percentage Rushing: Underwood, 47 yards on 9 carries, 1 TD Receiving: J.J. Buchanan, 126 yards on 6 catches, 1 TD Last game Oklahoma won 51-0 over UTEP on Sept. 4. Mateer threw for 225 yards on 11-of-17 attempts (64.7%) with three touchdowns and no interceptions. Avant had 79 rushing yards on 15 carries and one touchdown, adding one reception for six yards. Sategna had four receptions for 76 yards and one touchdown. Michigan defeated Western Michigan 13-12 on Sept. 5. Underwood passed for 170 yards on 12-of-22 attempts (54.5%) with one touchdown and one interception. He also carried the ball nine times for 47 yards and one rushing touchdown. Jordan Marshall carried the ball 11 times for 44 yards, adding two receptions for 17 yards. Buchanan recorded 126 yards on six catches with one touchdown. Next game Oklahoma hosts New Mexico on Sept. 19. Michigan hosts UTEP on Sept. 19.
